TEST1001 Introduction to Economics
Week 04 Slides

Slide 1: Keynesian Cross
The Keynesian cross compares planned aggregate expenditure with actual output.

Slide 2: Planned Expenditure
Planned expenditure is the amount households, firms, government, and foreign buyers plan to spend on domestic output.

Slide 3: Equilibrium
In the simple Keynesian model, equilibrium occurs where planned expenditure equals actual output.

Slide 4: Multiplier
The expenditure multiplier shows how an initial autonomous spending change can lead to a larger change in equilibrium output.

Slide 5: Marginal Propensity to Consume
The marginal propensity to consume is the fraction of an additional dollar of income that households spend on consumption.
